canonical_statement: For spaces X and Y and coefficients in a principal ideal domain R, under the usual freeness hypotheses for the singular chain complexes, the homology of X x Y fits into the natural Kunneth short exact sequence whose left term is the direct sum of tensor products of homology groups and whose right term is the corresponding direct sum of Tor groups.
domain_and_universes: Topological spaces X and Y; a principal ideal domain R; graded R-modules arising as singular homology. Lean universes and category instances remain to be frozen.
hypotheses: the singular chain complexes satisfy the freeness/flatness conditions required by the selected Kunneth theorem
tensor products, Tor, and homology are taken over the same coefficient ring R
conclusion: A natural short exact sequence 0 -> direct_sum_{p+q=n}(H_p(X;R) tensor_R H_q(Y;R)) -> H_n(X x Y;R) -> direct_sum_{p+q=n-1} Tor_1^R(H_p(X;R), H_q(Y;R)) -> 0, with any splitting treated as noncanonical unless stronger data are supplied.
